name: Two-scale Lorenz '96 simulation dataset
size_as_stated: 9995 points for memory-based parameterization and 9999 points for instantaneous parameterizations
resolution: K=8 slow variables, J=32 fast variables per slow variable (total dim 264); simulated dt=0.005, sub-sampled to 1t=0.01; t=0 to 100 MTU (500 ATM days)

scales.note: Lorenz '96 dynamical system without spatial metric coordinates; 1 MTU = 5 atmospheric days (432,000 s), sampled at dt = 0.01 MTU (4,320 s) over 100 MTU (500 days).
